intro.title: Meet your Character
intro.description1: Upload the best photos of yourself with varied expressions, angles, and poses to shape your unique AI twin!
intro.description2: Like a real photoshoot, a little prep delivers authentic, pro-level results.
intro.privacy: Your uploads are private and secure.

confirmation.title: Like a real photo shoot, a little prep goes a long way.
confirmation.paragraph1: Primeshot creates high quality portraits from your everyday photos. Clear, well lit, and varied photos make your generated shoots more natural and impressive. Low quality or blurry photos can limit results.
confirmation.paragraph2: If results are not what you expected, try a new set of photos in a fresh Character.

naturalLight.title: Natural Light
naturalLight.description: Use well-lit photos by a window or outside! Avoid dark or blurry for sharp results.

angles.title: Angles
angles.description: Mix it up with angles! Pick shoulder-ups, front and side, add a few waist-ups.

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.description: Express your vibe with varied smiles, poses. Skip same-face for dynamic shots.

variety.title: Variety
variety.description: Pick shots with a mix of clothing and backgrounds.

uploadStep.bodyShotBypassExplanation: You can continue without body shots, but it won't be a true representation of yourself

header.title: Create a Character
header.description: Upload {{minImages}} high-quality photos of yourself to train a reusable Character that captures your true likeness in every shoot.

tips.blurredBackground: Use blurred backgrounds for clear subject separation.
tips.naturalLight: Stand near a window or go outside for natural light!
tips.photos: Include both close-up and waist-up photos.
tips.expression: Keep your expression neutral or naturally friendly.
tips.avoid: Skip filters, hats, heavy makeup, or AI-generated images.
tips.clothing: Wear simple clothing in solid colors or subtle patterns.
tips.quantity: Upload {{minImages}}+ photos with different angles and lighting.

dodonts.eyes: Look at the camera with your eyes clearly visible.
dodonts.lighting: Use bright, natural lighting. Skip dark or blurry photos.
dodonts.frame: Make sure you're alone in the frame—no clutter or other people.
dodonts.face: Frame your face so it's not too small or cut off.

image.lowResolution: Low resolution image. Minimum size is {{minWidth}}x{{minHeight}}px.
image.suboptimalResolution: Image resolution is {{currentWidth}}x{{currentHeight}}px. For best results, use at least {{idealWidth}}x{{idealHeight}}px.
image.suboptimalResolutionLow: Image resolution is {{currentWidth}}x{{currentHeight}}px (below 800px). Consider using at least 800x800px for better quality.

face.lowScore: Face detection score could be improved.
face.angleExtreme: Face angle is too extreme (pitch: {{pitch}}°, yaw: {{yaw}}°, roll: {{roll}}°)
face.sunglasses: Eyes are obscured by sunglasses or dark glasses.
face.eyesClosed: Eyes appear to be closed or not visible.
face.tooSmall: Face is too small in the frame.
face.tooSmallToDetect: Face is too small and hard to detect.

separation.nearlyIdentical: Subject and background are nearly identical in tone - use a strongly contrasting background.
separation.tooSimilar: Subject and background are too similar in tone - consider using a contrasting background.
separation.couldBeMoreDistinct: Subject and background could be more distinct - try a different background color.

contrast.poorOrFlat: Image has poor contrast or appears too flat.

sharpness.tooBlurry: Image appears to be blurry or lacks sufficient detail.
sharpness.pixelated: Image appears pixelated or has compression artifacts.
sharpness.tooBlurryOrPixelated: Image is too blurry or pixelated - use higher quality camera.

bokeh.batchRejection: Most images lack background blur - use portrait mode or stand further from background.

filter.strong: Strong beauty or color filter detected - please use natural photo.

duplicate.tooSimilar: Too similar to images {{similar}} - add more variety.
duplicate.highSimilarity: Similarity score {{score}}% with {{count}} other images - reduce similarity.
duplicate.burstShot: Appears to be burst shot - nearly identical to {{count}} other images
duplicate.sameSession: Looks too similar to other images - add more variety

background.notBlurred: Background is not blurred. Please use portrait mode or a blurred background.
